name: 苏敏
source: 《猫眼之后》角色圣经 02_characters.md 第 4 节（character_id: su_min）。注：圣经规定成片只出现右手、右眼与部分黑发，不露全脸；本次完整四视图仅作内部一致性参考（给 Codex 做服装与手部锚定），成片仍按圣经只用局部，不因此改动剧情或角色设定

identity.en: A thirty-one-year-old Chinese woman, 165 cm tall and slim, living in an old apartment block in a second-tier Chinese city in the present day
identity.text: 当代二线城市老公寓 704 的住户，身高 165cm、偏瘦（身高体型圣经未写，本项为补全）

face.en: A pale oval face with hollow cheeks and a soft jawline, dark brown eyes, the eyelids puffy and swollen as if she has been crying, a small dark mole just below her right eye, on the left side of the image, a straight narrow nose, pale dry lips, no makeup
face.text: 鹅蛋脸偏清瘦、脸颊略陷，深褐眼睛，眼睑浮肿像刚哭过，右眼下方一颗泪痣，鼻子窄直，嘴唇苍白发干，素颜

hair.en: Long straight black hair worn loose, falling past the shoulders, the ends faded to dark brown, slightly dry and tangled
hair.text: 黑色长直发，松散垂到肩下，发尾染过的深棕已褪色，发丝有点干、有点乱

build.en: 165 cm and thin, small-framed with narrow shoulders, standing a little drawn in with rounded shoulders
build.text: 165cm、偏瘦，骨架小、肩窄，站着有点缩着肩

skin.en: Very pale, almost bloodless skin with fine visible pores, dry lips, faint shadows under the eyes, no makeup at all
skin.text: 皮肤苍白几乎没有血色，毛孔细可见，嘴唇发干，眼下有淡淡的青影，完全不化妆

backCue.en: Her long black hair falling loose down her back, fading to dark brown at the ends, over the plain back of the beige knit dress
backCue.text: 黑色长直发披在后背、发尾转深棕，下面是米色针织长裙素净的后片

top.en: a beige fine-knit long-sleeved dress with a soft round neckline, the cuffs pilled from wear
top.text: 米色细针织长袖连衣裙，圆领，袖口起球

bottom.en: the skirt of the same beige knit dress, falling to mid-calf, and bare feet
bottom.text: 同一条米色针织裙的下摆到小腿中段，赤脚（鞋子圣经未写，按室内地毯场景补全）

details.en: the thin silver bracelet with three small beads on her right wrist, and a small healed bite mark on the second knuckle of her right index finger, her nails short and unpolished
details.text: 右腕细银手链带三颗小珠，右手食指第二指节一处愈合的咬痕，指甲剪得短、没有甲油

details.en: the pilled cuff of her beige knit dress, the fine wool bobbled and softened from wear
details.text: 米色针织裙的袖口，起了小球、磨得发软

details.en: the soft round neckline of her beige knit dress, slightly stretched out of shape
details.text: 米色针织裙的软圆领，略微松垮变形

details.en: the ends of her long black hair, faded to dark brown at the tips and a little dry and split
details.text: 黑色长发的发尾，染过的深棕已褪，发梢有点干、有分叉
